Home programme, right shoulder (rotator cuff strain)

Weeks 1-2: gentle pendulum swings, 2 minutes, three times a day. Shoulder blade squeezes, 10 repetitions. Avoid lifting anything heavier than a mug and avoid sleeping on the right side. Heat before exercises is fine; ice afterwards for 10 minutes if sore. Do not push into sharp pain, a dull ache is acceptable.

Weeks 3-4: add wall slides and external rotation with a light band, 3 sets of 12. You may start driving short distances when you can turn the wheel without pain. Swimming is still off limits.

Week 5 onwards: progress to the red resistance band and add rows. Return to the gym only after your review appointment with me on 17 June at 4pm. Bring the band so I can check your form.

HOLIDAY AND LEAVE POLICY v4

Purpose: This policy sets out how annual leave and other absences are managed at Delta Logistics. It applies to all employees, including part-time staff, who receive leave pro rata.

Annual leave: Full-time employees receive 25 days plus public holidays. The leave year runs from 1 April to 31 March. Requests should be submitted at least two weeks in advance through the HR portal and approved by your line manager. Leave for periods over five consecutive days requires four weeks' notice.

Carry-over: Up to 5 days may be carried into the next leave year with manager approval. Any leave carried over must be used by 30 June, after which it is lost.

Sickness: Absence of more than 7 calendar days requires a doctor's note. Employees should phone their manager before 9:30 on the first day of absence; texting is not sufficient.

Compassionate leave: Up to 3 paid days following the death of a close family member.

Questions: hr@deltalogistics.example

Subject: Community Arts Fund 2026 - call for applications

The Riverside Foundation is pleased to announce the opening of the 2026 Community Arts Fund. Grants of between 2,000 and 10,000 pounds are available to small organisations and informal groups delivering arts activity in the north-east. Priority will be given to projects that involve young people or people who have not previously accessed funding.

Eligible applicants must be constituted groups or work with a fiscal sponsor. Individuals may apply only through a sponsor. Projects must be completed within twelve months of the award. Funds cannot be used for capital building works or to cover existing salaries.

Applications are made through our online form. You will need a short budget, two references and a copy of your safeguarding policy. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Decisions will be announced in late September.

The fund opens on 1 May and applications close at midday on 12 June. Late applications cannot be accepted under any circumstances.

Riverside Foundation, Grants Team
